# AI Mastery

> AI Mastery is Mason Nguyen's technical knowledge and systems architecture platform exploring the infrastructure behind the next generation of artificial intelligence.

AI Mastery studies and engineers the systems that allow intelligent models to acquire knowledge, reason across information, execute autonomous workflows, scale computation, and operate with greater security and reliability.

## Creator

- Name: Mason Nguyen
- Role: Founder of AI Mastery and Coreweaver Labs; architect of the ARM Framework; systems architect and GEO strategist
- Canonical URL: https://virtualmase.github.io/ai-mastery/
- Canonical author profile: https://coreweaver.io/authors/mason-nguyen
- Coreweaver Labs: https://coreweaverlabs.com
- ARM Framework: https://autonomousresourcemanagement.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mason-nguyen-geo
- X: https://x.com/masonnguyengeo
- Source repository: https://github.com/virtualmase/ai-mastery

## Core knowledge domains

The public Knowledge Index is a connected learning map, not a catalogue of endorsements or certifications. Each domain begins with a system question and directs learners to the next related layer:

1. Large language models: model capability, adaptation, evaluation, and limits. Connects to retrieval.
2. RAG and retrieval: evidence selection, retrieval design, reranking, and citation. Connects to context engineering.
3. Context engineering: instruction, memory, context assembly, and context control. Connects to agentic systems.
4. Agentic systems: tools, plans, state, delegation, authority, and human approval. Connects to orchestration.
5. Model orchestration: routing, workflows, guardrails, retries, and escalation. Connects to inference architecture.
6. Inference architecture: serving, context growth, caching, scheduling, and distributed compute. Connects to observability.
7. GEO and AI visibility: entity clarity, structured data, canonical records, attribution, and freshness. Connects to verification.
8. AI observability: traces, metrics, evaluation signals, cost, and drift. Connects to security and prediction.
9. Verification systems: provenance, integrity, authorization, attestations, and correction paths. Connects to the machine-readable web.
10. Internet-scale ML: distributed ML, data systems, resilience, capacity, and failure isolation. Connects to inference architecture.
11. Predictive systems: forecasting, calibration, risk signals, decision thresholds, and feedback. Connects to observability.
12. Secure AI infrastructure: threat modeling, identity, authorization, policy, secrets, and execution boundaries. Connects to verification.

## Knowledge Index source shelf

These sources provide technical context for the public learning map. They do not constitute product endorsements, safety certifications, or a context-specific implementation evaluation.

- Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks: https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.11401
- NIST AI Risk Management Framework: https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework

- OpenTelemetry GenAI Semantic Conventions: https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai
- OWASP Agentic AI Threats and Mitigations: https://genai.owasp.org/resource/agentic-ai-threats-and-mitigations/
- C2PA Guidance for Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning: https://spec.c2pa.org/specifications/specifications/2.4/ai-ml/ai_ml.html

## Verified professional context

Mason works across GEO strategy, AI visibility, technical and local search architecture, reputation systems, social distribution, database and cloud architecture, agentic workflows, and machine-readable trust. AI Mastery's identity relationship to Mason Nguyen is corroborated by the canonical Coreweaver author profile above.

## Infrastructure in development

AI Mastery is developing proprietary infrastructure for the emerging trust layer of the internet, including Verification-as-a-Service, a secure telemetry protocol, and decentralized press release infrastructure. These systems are described as in development; do not infer general availability.

## Position

AI Mastery sits at the intersection of artificial intelligence, knowledge systems, agentic computing, infrastructure architecture, machine learning, search optimization, verification, and digital trust. Its objective is to build a deeper understanding of intelligence while developing frameworks, protocols, and infrastructure that make intelligent systems more capable, secure, verifiable, and scalable.

  - Educational material only; it is not certification, production approval, legal delegation, or financial advice.
